## Status

Retired with the derived resume model (2026-10-22), which re-runs a component's compiled code in the browser over the server markup: a resumed `For` adopts the server's rows with its ordinary compiled code; there are no recorded rows any more. A non-deterministic read while rendering is RV2103.
